name: Solenne
flavour: She brings the noon with her.
art_prompt: a slender woman in a glossy black latex catsuit with a high collar, knee-high black boots, black gloves; her head is a bright yellow cartoon sun: a smooth round yellow face with calm half-lidded eyes, thin brows and small red lips, ringed by eight long pointed golden-yellow rays; standing straight, both arms relaxed at her sides
motion: walking in place with a slow confident catwalk sway, arms swinging gently
anim_hint: a woman in a glossy black catsuit whose head is a yellow cartoon sun with pointed rays
anim_negative: a human head, hair, a helmet, a face on the body, a second head, a weapon, a cape
portrait_prompt: head and shoulders, her sun face looking at the viewer with a small knowing smile
hurt_hint: her sun face wincing, eyes shut, rays bent back
back_hint: She faces away: the back of the yellow sun head with its rays, the zip line down the black catsuit's back, the heels of the boots, no face at all. Both arms hang straight down.
pose_hint: Both arms hang straight down at her sides, hands open, not on the hips. The same slim proportions in every view.
trait_text: Gain 1.5% debuff duration per level (her burns, poison, slows and pins last longer; buffs do not).

SOL-A.note: Pass 54's walk on Garry's Walking_sun as first rendered: its side view turned a quarter away, her head grew walking down and shrank walking up.

SOL-B.note: Walking_sun again, fitted to her (tools/pose_fit.py): squared to her hips, her body, hands and sun disc at her painted size, the disc facing the viewer in every view, a side still with the disc turned to the viewer.

recipe.anim_hint: a woman in a glossy black catsuit whose head is a flat round yellow cartoon sun disc with pointed rays all around it, never seen edge-on
recipe.pose_motion: walking in place on the spot like on a treadmill, a light confident stride

SOL-C.note: Mixamo's Catwalk Walking (Garry's _REFERENCES/3d/Catwalk Walking.fbx), fitted to her the same way.

recipe.anim_hint: a woman in a glossy black catsuit whose head is a flat round yellow cartoon sun disc with pointed rays all around it, never seen edge-on
recipe.pose_motion: walking in place on the spot like on a treadmill, a catwalk stride with the hips swaying

SOL-D.note: The run every other hero uses (Mixamo Running), fitted to her the same way.

recipe.anim_hint: a woman in a glossy black catsuit whose head is a flat round yellow cartoon sun disc with pointed rays all around it, never seen edge-on
recipe.pose_motion: running in place on the spot like on a treadmill

SOL-E.note: the catwalk again, with a tighter prompt (pass 60): SOL-C's words ('a catwalk stride with the hips swaying') let the model add runway poses: a hand on the hip and a body turning through the three-quarter front cycle, a lean-back crouch in the side cycle. These say what each part of the body does and what stays put, and roll new seeds (anim_seed 4). The three-quarter back view walks on catwalk_fit_wide_spread (pose_spread at 0.10): on the 0.06 spread the driver's wrists passed the hips at hip height and Wan planted both hands on them, elbows out.

recipe.anim_hint: a slender woman in a glossy black latex catsuit, black gloves and knee-high black boots, her head a flat round yellow cartoon sun disc with pointed rays all round it, the disc turned flat to the camera like a badge with its whole round face showing, the same slim proportions and the same height in every frame
recipe.pose_motion: walking in place on the spot like on a treadmill with a slow catwalk stride: one foot placed straight in front of the other on one line, the hips swaying from side to side, the shoulders level and still, the chin up, both arms hanging loose at her sides and swinging gently, the hands open and away from the hips, her body facing the same way the whole time
recipe.anim_negative: a human head, hair, a helmet, a face on the body, a second head, a weapon, a cape, turning round, a hand on the hip, hands behind the back, arms crossed, the sun disc seen edge-on, crouching, bending forward, jumping, a second figure
recipe.back_hint: the back of the yellow sun disc with its rays and no face, the zip line down the catsuit's back, the heels of the boots; both arms swing loosely at her sides and never reach behind her back

badge.note: pass 56: a Klein close-up with a wink and a sly smile (tools/dl/stills56, c0 of six), the whole sun across 80 % of the badge, solid shoulders below
